limitations: BrushlessMotor fault/class and acquisition session/time are inseparable; performance does not identify isolated mechanical fault effects.
RA has33 test parents,6 source-validation parents and18 adaptation parents;234/232 pooled test classes but target only20 normal/116 anomaly. No plant-prevalence interpretation of AP/precision.

Bootstrap intervals condition on observed cohort and fixed seed set; do not include seed-sampling, train-sampling, new machine/site/session uncertainty. No multiplicity-controlled significance procedure.
Phase1 signal-quality inspection and Phase2.1/2.2 common-test smoke access contradict blanket raw-test-unopened/R11 wording; first-test performance ledger is not a universal data-access log.

Machine-level spectral target rates were fixed from release audit before model performance, not estimated anew from each training cohort; train-only fitted scaling remains separate. Documentation implying all reference rates are train-derived is imprecise.

Stored F1 uses the existing precision/recall implementation and returns null when precision+recall=0, including some TP0/error cases where count-form F1 would be0. Preserve first-test values; independent reporting review needed, no silent correction.
README/research definition/supervisor report have stale no-model/no-results wording; leakage register retains superseded bootstrap/significance and planned-path language.
Earlier v1/v2 configs are historical, not valid primary configs; later freeze scopes override older global language.
No full estimator checkpoint was saved; first-test reproduction was recorded exact in Phase3.2 but not rerun during recovery. Shared global pip environment is not dependency-clean.
